column1: # STEPS.tsv -- THE DESIGN-PLAN fleet-control STEP TABLE (the cio, 2026-11-07 12:0x, on Lon's word in the cio's window, verbatim: "It is time to fix the desgin of the fleet and gain control of the CPU problem." / "So it appears we have 99 useless tasks to improve the fleet. It is time to SCRAP it and do it again the correct way." / "Stop the FLEET. Time for ONE WORKER. You." / "maximize sharing cpu and disk. queue and limit as necessary. use modern industry proven tools." / "You are the BOSS of the DAMN FLEET."; the design text is .github/skills/shared-box/reference.md section 9; the 71 live rows of the six older plans (box-scheduler, fleet-queue, test-cycle, box-budget, shared-dev, batch-grader) are SUPERSEDED by this plan).

# harness/scripts/test_design_fleet_control_steps.sh reads it: --list prints it; --step N runs the step's PROBE (column 5, one bash command run from S4E_HOME with a 600 s budget): rc 0 GREEN, rc 1 RED, rc 2 could not measure. Every step is a MEASURED OUTCOME on the box, never a mechanism; the executor of every step is the cio by its own hand (no worker row, Lon 2026-11-07).

# THE TOOLS (standard, no hand-rolled copy): systemd slices and scopes (cgroup v2: CPUQuota, CPUWeight, MemoryHigh, MemoryMax) for the kernel-enforced caps; the GNU make jobserver (box-wide fifo) for compiles; GNU parallel sem for admission of runs, landings and batch jobs; beanstalkd for the work queue; flock for the landing lease; ccache and the shared git object store for disk; systemd-tmpfiles for scratch; PSI (/proc/pressure) as the one control signal; one Python process on a systemd timer as the controller.
# Columns: step, slug, executor, depends (steps), probe.

column5: head -1 /proc/pressure/cpu | grep -qE 'avg300=' && uptime | grep -q 'load average' && test -f harness/scripts/s4e_land.sh

grep -q 'LAND_PROBE_GREEN' harness/scripts/s4e_land.sh && test -s /home/resources/progress/LAND_PROBE_GREEN.tsv && timeout 60 bash harness/scripts/s4e_land.sh --probe 2>&1 | grep -q '^LAND dry-run ok (cached' && ! grep -q 's4e_land.sh --probe`, then' .github/skills/fleet-bus/SKILL.md

systemctl --user show s4e-seats.slice -p CPUQuotaPerSecUSec --value | grep -qE '^1[0-2]s$' && grep -qP '^seats\ts4e-seats\.slice\t' /home/resources/postoffice/BUDGET.tsv && grep -q 's4e-seats.slice' .github/scripts/spawn_fleet.sh && [ "$(systemctl --user show app-org.gnome.Terminal.slice -p CPUQuotaPerSecUSec --value)" = infinity ] && [ "$(systemctl --user list-units --type=scope --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^s4e-seat-')" -ge 1 ]
grep -qP '^land\t' harness/scripts/SLOTS.tsv && grep -qE 'util_run_slot.sh"? --admit land' harness/scripts/s4e_land.sh && timeout 120 bash harness/scripts/util_run_slot.sh --admit land true

test -f harness/scripts/box_tick.py && S4E_TICK_DRY=1 timeout 120 python3 -I harness/scripts/box_tick.py --tick 2>&1 | grep -qE '^TICK .*cpu_s=0\.[0-9]+' && grep -q 'box_tick.py' "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/systemd/user/s4e-tick.service" && systemctl --user is-active -q s4e-tick.timer

grep -q 'util_run_slot.sh --admit run' harness/scripts/handoff_status.sh && grep -qE 'util_run_slot.sh"? --admit (run|land)' harness/scripts/s4e_land.sh && grep -q 's4e-batch.slice' harness/scripts/util_seat_census.py

ccache -p 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'max_size = ([3-9][0-9])\.0 GB' && [ "$(df --output=pcent /home | tail -1 | tr -dc 0-9)" -lt 80 ] && test -s "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/user-tmpfiles.d/s4e.conf"

grep -qE '^WORKERS-AWAKE: ([89]|1[0-9]|20)\b' /home/resources/postoffice/MODE && fl="$(grep -m1 '^FLEET: IDLE EXCEPT' /home/resources/postoffice/MODE)" && case "$fl" in *'(controller'*) ;; *) exit 1;; esac && [ "$(printf '%s' "$fl" | sed 's/(controller.*//' | grep -oE 'worker_[0-9]+' | wc -l)" -ge 8 ] && head -1 /proc/pressure/cpu | grep -oE 'avg300=[0-9.]+' | awk -F= '{exit !($2 < 20)}' && timeout 120 python3 -I harness/scripts/util_seat_census.py --cpu-check 2>&1 | grep -q '^  GREEN cpu pressure under 30'

! awk -F'\t' '!/^#/ && $4 ~ /^(SUPERSEDED|RETIRED)(:|$)/' /home/resources/postoffice/QUEUE.tsv | grep -q . && test -s /home/resources/postoffice/QUEUE.retired.tsv && timeout 120 python3 -I harness/scripts/util_queue_view.py --probe-retire 2>&1 | grep -q 'ok=1$'

timeout 120 python3 -I harness/scripts/box_tick.py --probe-feed 2>&1 | grep -q 'ok=1$' && ! find /home/resources/postoffice/test_requests -maxdepth 1 -name '*.req' -mmin +3 -exec grep -L -E '^(fed|served)=' {} + 2>/dev/null | grep -q .
timeout 120 bash harness/scripts/s4e_stop_gate.sh --probe-queue 2>&1 | grep -q 'tier_tube_ready=BLOCK tier_tube_empty=BLOCK longpoll=1$'

timeout 120 bash harness/scripts/s4e_stop_gate.sh --probe-queue 2>&1 | grep -q 'longpoll=1$' && grep -q 'S4E_NEXT_WAIT' harness/scripts/s4e_msg.sh && t0=$(date +%s) && S4E_NO_BANNER=1 timeout 60 bash harness/scripts/s4e_msg.sh next --wait 3 >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $(( $(date +%s) - t0 )) -ge 3 ]
